label: nyiso 34 st tempfloor
definition: nyiso-34 builds on the nyiso-33 ct-tempfloor keeper and adds a temperature-keyed downstate ST_GAS (gas-steam) local-reliability floor (--nyiso-st-reliability-floor), the ST-fleet companion to the CT floor. MECHANISM: NYISO's downstate steam fleet (NYC zone J Ravenswood/Arthur Kill/Astoria; Long Island; Capital) runs a persistent in-city/cable-islanded reliability baseline an energy-only LP zeroes out (it imports cheaper CC instead), so the backcast under-runs ST_GAS. The floor is a persistent 24h baseline with an evening cooling hot-limb layered over HB14-21 via maximum, applied per-unit pro-rata (each in-pocket unit floored at frac x its OWN available capacity), keyed per zone to its load-center daily max temperature (Islip/Central Park/Albany, NOAA GHCN). Carries two structural corrections it depends on (when-available CF basis; the second per the attestation) plus a benchmark-basis fix, all flagged as methodology fixes, not residual tunes. Verdict CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS: 4 documented caveats + storage unscored; C6 attested.
